request: 制作一个插件，使aide可以自动寻找对应的skill并安装进引用中，这种skill一般都是放到aide的自身缓存目录中的
acceptance: Upgrade the existing skill preset into an uploadable executable plugin: search public GitHub skills by task keywords, prepare a pinned skill URL/repository directory, list visible installed references.
Default catalog uses openai/skills and anthropics/skills; configurable public repositories and explicit GitHub Skill URLs are supported, without credentials.
Store downloaded instructions/resources/scripts in Aide-owned cache, never an assumed workspace or Codex skill directory; register as a Skill reference after existing management confirmation.

Preserve separate Aide/assistant reference management permissions, workspace revision, hidden/disabled/read-write locks, plugin enable/deny and locked/read-only refusal. Never execute downloaded scripts or install dependencies.

Pin commit and Git blob integrity, bound downloads/files/paths, reject unsafe URLs/symlinks/submodules, reuse cache safely, retain provenance/license, package ZIP and test against real plugin host and isolated HTTP/Go integration.
scope: plugins/skill manifest, self-contained entry, documentation and package builder
internal/server skill catalog/cache/management integration and focused tests
minimal workflow/assistant dispatch, source virtual cache path and documentation/task records

requirements.summary: User confirmed public GitHub with OpenAI/Anthropic defaults, configurable repositories or pasted skill links. Existing management confirmation and reference locks remain in force.

design.summary: Upgrade existing skill preset; native executor owns downloads/cache paths and preserves role/workspace/plugin/lock boundaries. Content-addressed immutable cache in AIDE_DATA with narrow virtual reference root. Existing human-confirmed reference proposals only.

implementation.summary: Added public GitHub catalog search/configured sources/precise URLs, commit/blob verification, full bounded resources/license caching, reviewable reference registration, duplicate/version handling and Aide/assistant native dispatch. ZIP is reproducible and independently host-validated.

verification.summary: 125 quick checks; isolated server Skill/Management/Authoring race regression; relevant Go vet and main build; macOS native tests and actual public GitHub catalog/download checks. Real ZIP import/native ownership, reference confirmation/read-only access, denial/cancel/tamper transitions verified on synthetic instances. Browser/paid model/production installation not run.

documentation.summary: Documented plugin installation/upgrade, native-host requirement, settings, cache path/limits, compatibility parsing, safety boundary and exact test/production status.

cleanup.summary: Removed own isolated test container and native test executable. Preserved deliverable ZIP, package metadata and ignored verification logs. Unrelated plugins/registry.json kept untouched and unstaged.

release.summary: No push, version bump, release, production restart or production plugin/reference mutation requested or performed. Local plugin ZIP is the deliverable.

rollback: Disable the skill plugin first; reject pending skill reference proposals. Restore prior source/image/plugin together if rolling back native support. Do not delete shared skill-cache versions until all references using them are removed; installed references are read-only by default and no dependency/script was executed.
handoff: Uploadable ZIP .agent-state/packages/aide-pkg-skill-v1.1.0.zip (6036 bytes, SHA256 ab7e49c3e8a90ec8b11453813ce6c0536f27dd4d4028b0acfd69a2afc509e9f7). Requires an Aide build containing the native skill_library executor; ZIP alone cannot update an older host. Existing skill ID uses the supported upgrade/Plugin Workshop prepare flow. No source pushed and running product unchanged. Preserve unrelated registry modifications.
